discoveredFiles.title: ERCOT Adjusted Load Forecast Winter 2025-2026 for RS Magnitude

scope: Complete original winter 2025-2026 workbook, including all 2160 hourly rows and the separate peak row; not actual demand observations or an as-issued forecast backtest.
comparison: All 49,704 published load values, operator labels, source dates and hour labels match independent python-calamine reads; runtime uses openpyxl through existing workbook helpers.
limits: Transmission-operator allocations exclude large-load additions; these areas are not weather zones or settlement load zones.
The hourly table does not separately publish large-load additions; that field remains null rather than being calculated.
The peak row publishes 4817 in large-load additions and retains the explanatory contracted/officer-letter breakdown.
Forecast percentile is extracted from the original explanation. Source clocks and values are not timezone-adjusted or rescaled.
